title: literary_review
description: Shared structured review payload every literary reviewer emits and the revise stage consumes. Complementary to the framework reviewer envelope (argus_skill/reviewer/reviewer_schema.json, which carries the round OUTCOME): this is the domain FINDING list. `severity` (critical|major|minor|note) is the IMPORTANCE axis; `blocking` is the INDEPENDENT gate axis — they are deliberately decoupled so a serious-but-non-gating craft note (critical, non-blocking) and a hard continuity contradiction (blocking) are both expressible. `type` is a free string validated against a PER-VERTICAL vocabulary by literary.review_contract, never hardcoded here.
